events.name: Bash
events.head: Check commit ancestry and contents, find guide scripts
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; git fetch -q origin main 2>&1|tail -2; git merge-base --is-ancestor 512c734 origin/main && echo ANCESTOR; git show --stat --format='%h %s' 512c734 | head -40; ls app/scripts | grep -i guide; ls cloud/scripts | grep -i guide

events.name: Bash
events.head: Verify the 11 WebPs and guide references
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; for f in s1-overview/03 s2-tantra-pro-funnel/16 s4-challenge/08 s4-challenge/11 s4-challenge/16 s4-rsp/14 s5-challenge-stages/01 s5-rsp-stages/01 s5-rsp-stages/02 s5-webinar-stages/01 s6-sms/03; do p=app/public/guides/$f.webp; echo "$f $(file -b $p | cut -c1-40) $(git diff --quiet 512c734 HEAD -- $p && echo same || echo changed)"; done; grep -n "0[0-9]\.webp\|1[0-9]\.webp\|capture_needed" app/src/content/guides/s5-pipeline/s5-rsp-stages.ts | head; head -30 app/scripts/check-guides.mjs | grep -n "usage\|node\|PORT\|only"

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check references and run check-guides
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; for f in s1-overview/03 s2-tantra-pro-funnel/16 s4-challenge/08 s4-challenge/11 s4-challenge/16 s4-rsp/14 s5-challenge-stages/01 s5-rsp-stages/01 s5-rsp-stages/02 s5-webinar-stages/01 s6-sms/03; do echo "$f refs=$(grep -rl "/guides/$f.webp" app/src/content/guides | wc -l)"; done; cd app && node scripts/check-guides.mjs 2>&1 | tail -6; sed -n 1,25p scripts/probe-guides.mjs | grep -n "BASE\|only\|PORT\|usage\|node"

events.name: Bash
events.head: Inspect s4 guide refs for new captures
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; git show 512c734 -- app/src/content/guides/s4-conversion/ | grep "^[-+]" | cut -c1-220; grep -n "08.webp\|11.webp\|16.webp\|14.webp\|IMG\|const .*guides" app/src/content/guides/s4-conversion/s4-challenge.ts app/src/content/guides/s4-conversion/s4-rsp.ts | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Confirm s4 shot helper wiring at HEAD
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; grep -n "shot(8,\|shot(11,\|shot(16,\|capture_needed" app/src/content/guides/s4-conversion/s4-challenge.ts | cut -c1-120; grep -n "shot(14,\|capture_needed" app/src/content/guides/s4-conversion/s4-rsp.ts | cut -c1-120; grep -n "function shot\|const shot" app/src/content/guides/s4-conversion/s4-challenge.ts app/src/content/guides/s4-conversion/s4-rsp.ts; grep -n "s4-challenge\|s4-rsp" app/scripts/check-guides.mjs | head -3; lsof -ti:4322 | head -2

events.text: All 11 captures are on disk, wired into the guides, and unchanged since 512c734, and check-guides passes. Next I'm running probe-guides against a local server.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check probe usage and running servers
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/app; sed -n 8,40p scripts/probe-guides.mjs | grep -n "URL\|only\|localhost" | head; for p in 3000 4322 3100; do echo "$p $(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' --max-time 5 http://localhost:$p/debug/guides)"; done

events.name: Bash
events.head: Start local dev server on port 4391
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/app; nohup npx next dev -p 4391 > /tmp/t135-dev.log 2>&1 & echo $! > /tmp/t135-dev.pid; for i in $(seq 1 30); do c=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' --max-time 60 http://localhost:4391/debug/guides); [ "$c" = 200 ] && break; sleep 3; done; echo "pid $(cat /tmp/t135-dev.pid) code $c"

events.name: Bash
events.head: Run probe-guides on the 8 guides
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/app; for g in s5-webinar-stages s5-challenge-stages s5-rsp-stages s6-sms s4-challenge s4-rsp s2-tantra-pro-funnel s1-overview; do r=$(timeout 280 node scripts/probe-guides.mjs "http://localhost:4391/debug/guides?only=$g" 2>&1 | tail -2 | tr '\n' ' '); echo "$g: $r"; done
